title: Venue research findings
description: What one venue researcher found about one venue in the weekly venue run: proposed values for profile fields, each with word-for-word quotes. One file per venue per researcher at data/venue-research/<run-date>/<venue-id>.<aspect>.json. Findings are not published: the venue editor compares them with the published profile and decides.

aspect.description: reviews = reviews and articles (summary, crowd, music, status news); programme = the kind of events, past listings and music genres; facts = address, website, access, cost, age, capacity.

field.description: A venue profile field, named as in venue evidence (summary, crowd, types, status, music.styles, accessibility.step_free, cost.notes …).

value.description: The proposed value, in the profile's format (a string in our own words, a list of styles, true/false, a number).

source_date.description: When the source was published or last updated, if the page says (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Old sources can't back crowd, music or access.

not_found.description: Fields this researcher looked for and couldn't find in writing.
